name: mrf-relay-service
description: Standalone service that handles Server 4 (MRF SMS) number purchases on Heroku, where a single request can run up to ~30s — unlike Vercel's free plan, which hard-kills anything over ~10s. The frontend calls this directly (bypassing Vercel) specifically for buying a Server 4 number, so the long wait for a slow MRF response happens here instead of running into Vercel's limit.
